product.name: Ultra-Fast Scanning Sensor
product.description: Ultra-fast direct conversion CdTe-CMOS linear scanning sensor for dental panoramic, cephalometric, medical, and industrial X-ray imaging. Single-photon sensitivity.

offer.description: OEM and system integrator sales. Contact Athlos for quote and integration support.

q1.question: What applications is the Ultra-Fast Scanning Sensor designed for?
q1.answer: The Ultra-Fast Scanning Sensor is designed for dental panoramic and cephalometric imaging, as well as medical and industrial X-ray inspection applications.

q2.question: What detector material does the Ultra-Fast Scanning Sensor use?
q2.answer: The Ultra-Fast Scanning Sensor uses CdTe-CMOS direct conversion technology — cadmium telluride bump-bonded to a full-custom CMOS readout ASIC.

q3.question: Does the Ultra-Fast Scanning Sensor support single-photon sensitivity?
q3.answer: Yes. The CdTe-CMOS direct conversion architecture enables single-photon sensitivity across the full operating range.

q4.question: How many models of the Ultra-Fast Scanning Sensor are available?
q4.answer: Three models are available — UFS150, UFS225, and UFS460 — differentiated by active length to match specific application requirements.
